name: Old-Growth Fir in Ballard and Queen Anne Homes
title-tag: Old-Growth Fir Floors in Ballard & Queen Anne, Seattle
meta-description: The fir under your Ballard or Queen Anne carpet is old-growth — better wood than money can buy today. How we sand, finish, and keep it honey instead of orange.
post-summary: February 1, 2027 · The Douglas fir in Ballard bungalows and Queen Anne boxes is old-growth — tight-ringed, vertical-grain wood no mill can produce anymore. Why it’s worth refinishing over replacing, how we sand a soft floor without ruining it, and the finish choice that keeps it honey instead of pumpkin.
